title: Hogsbo earn Superettan title
description: Hogsbo - Sloga Uppsala 86-66 Hogsbo looked well-organized offensively handing out 24 assists. It was a great evening for naturalized Israeli guard Jonathan Peleg (191-1994) who led his team to a victory scoring 22 points, 5 rebounds and 5 assists. Croatian power forward Tony Vitali (203-1991) helped adding 17 points, 7 rebounds and 6 assists. Five Hogsbo players scored in double figures. Hogsbo's coach Thomas Stansfield used an eleven-player rotation which allowed the starters a little rest for the next games. The best for the losing side was Axel Nordstrom (194-1991) with a double-double by scoring 18 points and 13 rebounds and Bosnian-North Macedonian center Marko Dujkovic (226-1990) produced a double-double by scoring 15 points and 11 rebounds.
